name: deepsea-empty
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world.at = null; const B = state.background; Object.assign(B, { kind: "deepsea", figX: -120, figY: 60, things: [] });

name: deepsea-things
js: state.music.mute = true; state.world.at = null; const B = state.background; Object.assign(B, { kind: "deepsea", figX: -120, figY: 60, things: [] }); const K = ["coral", "shell", "starfish", "seafish", "chest", "anchor", "kelp", "seagrass", "seafan", "sealettuce"]; B.things = K.map((kind, i) => ({ kind, x: -400 + (i % 5) * 200, z: 345 + Math.floor(i / 5) * 55, seed: 50 + i, size: 100, ...structuredClone(THING_DEFAULTS[kind] || {}) })); B.things[1].shape = "conch"; B.things[6].color = SEAPLANT_COLORS[4];
